<function=python>

def knobTL():
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(len(L)) for c in range(len(L[0])) if L[r][c]=='N']
    return (min(r for r,c in cells), min(c for r,c in cells))
print("start", knobTL())
for _ in range(6):
    action(['RIGHT']); print("R", knobTL())
for _ in range(6):
    action(['LEFT']); print("L", knobTL())
for _ in range(8):
    action(['UP']); print("U", knobTL())
for _ in range(8):
    action(['DOWN']); print("D", knobTL())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
